# Localization Instructions for Rust WTA Locale Files

Auto-load `.github/skills/ensure-localization/SKILL.md` for flat locale YAML in
`tools/wta/locales/*.yml`.

This wrapper only declares the current YAML file scope. It does not imply that
the skill or checker applies to arbitrary configuration YAML.
